prompts.title: Install board support
prompts.text:
This will set up: VHDL tools and the programmer; the FPGA engine; Quartus Prime Lite and MAX 10 support (from Altera).
It uses about 12.6 GB on this computer once finished (have about 20 GB free).
It needs an internet connection.
Later it asks you for two free files from Altera and to accept Altera's licence.

prompts.title: DE10-Lite support file
prompts.text: Choose the DE10-Lite support file your course provides (mixfpga-de10-lite-support-1.1-macos-arm64.tar.gz). MIX-FPGA checks it before using it.

prompts.title: Altera's files found
prompts.text: Use QuartusLiteSetup-25.1std.0.1129-linux.run and max10-25.1std.0.1129.qdz from your Downloads folder? MIX-FPGA only reads them; it does not change or move them.
